customManagers.description: Read Docker image references from Unraid template <Repository> tags.

packageRules.description: Group all template image bumps in one weekly PR by default.

Auto-merge every update. Homelab policy: the cost of a bad bump is a revert; the cost of a review queue is silently running a five-month-old database. The old Milvus freeze existed only for memsearch #534, which is fixed.
Our own wrapper images — :main is a moving tag we manage in unraid-images, do not let Renovate try to bump these.
Keep majors visible in the dashboard even though they merge themselves.
